# ☕ Modern Java & JVM Systems Mastery Track

Welcome to the **Modern Java & JVM Systems Mastery Track** materialized by **Trak**.

This workspace is an in-depth curriculum covering Modern Java (Java 21 LTS), Project Loom Virtual Threads, JVM memory architecture (Heap, Metaspace, GC algorithms), pattern matching, sealed classes, and low-latency concurrency.

## 📚 Syllabus & Module Map

| Module | Title | Key Topics & Internals |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-jvm-toolchain` | JDK 21 LTS & Toolchain | JDK vs JRE, JVM bytecode, JIT compilation (C1/C2 tiers), Maven `pom.xml` |
| `01-basics-primitive-types-and-boxing` | Primitives & Autoboxing | Primitives vs Reference wrappers, Integer Cache (`-128..127`), identity traps |
| `02-oop-polymorphism-and-interfaces` | Sealed Classes & Interfaces | `sealed` / `permits`, default & private interface methods, `instanceof` patterns |
| `03-records-and-pattern-matching` | Records & Exhaustive Switch | Immutability, compact record constructors, pattern matching for `switch` |
| `04-strings-and-text-blocks` | Strings & Text Blocks | String pool, byte array compact strings, String Deduplication, Text Blocks (`"""`) |
| `05-collections-framework-internals` | Collections Internals | `ArrayList` capacity, `HashMap` treeification (threshold 8), `ConcurrentHashMap` |
| `06-generics-and-type-erasure` | Generics & PECS | Bytecode type erasure, bridge methods, wildcards (`? extends T` vs `? super T`) |
| `07-functional-interfaces-and-lambdas` | Functional Interfaces | `@FunctionalInterface`, method references (`Class::method`), `java.util.function` |
| `08-streams-api-and-lazy-evaluation` | Streams API & Pipelines | Intermediate vs terminal operations, lazy pipelines, `Collectors`, parallel streams |
| `09-optional-and-null-safety` | Optional Monad Pattern | `Optional<T>`, monadic chaining (`map`, `flatMap`), avoiding `NullPointerException` |
| `10-error-handling-and-exceptions` | Exception Architecture | Checked vs Unchecked exceptions, try-with-resources (`AutoCloseable`), multi-catch |
| `11-concurrency-threads-and-virtual-threads` | Project Loom Virtual Threads | `Thread.ofVirtual()`, carrier threads, high-throughput non-blocking I/O |
| `12-synchronization-and-locks` | Locks & Memory Visibility | `synchronized`, `ReentrantLock`, `volatile` memory visibility (happens-before) |
| `13-jvm-memory-model-and-gc` | JVM Memory & GC Algorithms | Young/Old Gen Heap, Metaspace, G1GC, ZGC low-latency collector |
| `14-reflection-and-annotations` | Reflection & Annotations | `Class<T>`, Method reflection, custom `@interface` annotations, retention policies |
| `15-io-nio-and-channels` | Modern NIO.2 & Channels | `java.nio.file.Path`, `ByteBuffer`, non-blocking channels, `Files.readString` |
| `16-unit-testing-with-junit5` | JUnit 5 & Mockito | `@Test`, `@ParameterizedTest`, assertions, test lifecycle |
| `17-serialization-and-json` | Serialization Architecture | Native serialization vulnerabilities, Jackson JSON databinding |
| `18-interview-questions-and-drills` | Interview Mastery Drills | Top 10 Java gotchas (String pool, `equals`/`hashCode`, virtual threads) |

---

## 🛠️ How to Practice
Each module contains:
- `README.md` — Deep theoretical explanation and architecture notes.
- `Example.java` — Fully runnable concept demonstration.
- `exercise/Starter.java` — Hands-on problem with `TODO` markers.
- `exercise/Solution.java` — Complete reference solution.
